accountNumber.description: Number of the account to which the balance inquiry relates

accountLevel.description:
Heirarchy level to which balance inquiry relates
Possible Values
G - Corporate Group
R - Corporate Relationship
A - Financial Account
C - Card

necessaryAmountAvailableRetail.description:
Returned when Account Type = C and transactionAmount and transactionAmountCurrency are included in the request
Possible Value
Y - Yes
N - No

wtpTierPercentage.description: Percentage value of wholesale travel product interchange tier

wtpTierCode.description: Code of wholesale travel product interchange tier

accountype.description:
Indicates the account Level or account type the account balance info is being returned for.
Possible values
Corporate Group
Corporate Relationship
Financial Account
Card
Cash
Foreign Currency Credit
Alternate Currency Credit
Declining Balance

limit.description: The maximum amount of credit that can be spent or the maximum amount allowed for cash withdrawals

outstandingBalance.description: Balance of authorized transactions that are not yet posted on account

totalUsage.description: Total amount of credit limit spent including outstanding balance

totalUsagePercentage.description: Percentage of total amount of credit limit spent including outstanding balance

availableLimit.description: Remaining limit available to spend or remaining limit available for cash withdrawal

availableLimitPercentage.description: The percent of the limit of that account which is allowed to be spent or to be withdrawn

temporaryLimitExpiry.description: Date when Temporary credit or cash Limit will cease to take effect. Returned when temporary credit or cash limit is active

permanentLimit.description: Amount of permanent credit or cash limit, when temporary limit is active. Returned when temporary credit or cash limit is active

startDate.description: Date when Foreign Currency Limit start to take effect

expiryDate.description: Date when Foreign Currency Limit or Declining Balance expires
